name: Hubertusheim
beschreibung: Hubertusheim welcomes guests to the sunny high valley of Leutasch in the scenic Seefeld region. Situated in tranquil natural surroundings, the property features comfortable holiday apartments and rooms enhanced by warm alpine woodwork. Private balconies offer panoramic views of the Wetterstein peaks and the Mieminger Chain. In winter, world-class cross-country ski trails run directly past the house, while summer brings endless hiking and biking trails through the valley and into the pristine Gaistal. The village center of Leutasch with local shops and restaurants is just minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy alpine holiday retreat in Leutasch in the Seefeld region offering mountain panoramas and serene nature.
